text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly—even a thirty-minute walk every day can make a big difference. Good sleep is also important, so aim for seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and spend time on activities you enjoy. Finally, keep a healthy work-life balance by not working too many hours and making time to relax. These simple habits can help you feel happier and more energetic.
